scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace=@attendance/web
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build:cloudflare && wrangler deploy --env staging
scripts.db:generate: npm run db:generate:postgres && npm run d1:generate:prisma
scripts.d1:migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:development: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc
scripts.d1:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --env staging
scripts.d1:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --env production
scripts.d1:validate:local: wrangler d1 execute DB --local --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --command "PRAGMA foreign_key_check; SELECT count(*) AS application_tables FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name != 'd1_migrations';"
scripts.d1:validate:development: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --command "PRAGMA foreign_key_check; SELECT count(*) AS application_tables FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name != 'd1_migrations';"
scripts.d1:validate:staging: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --env staging --command "PRAGMA foreign_key_check; SELECT count(*) AS application_tables FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name != 'd1_migrations';"
scripts.d1:validate:production: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --env production --command "PRAGMA foreign_key_check; SELECT count(*) AS application_tables FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND name NOT LIKE '_cf_%' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' AND name != 'd1_migrations';"
scripts.d1:import:staging: wrangler d1 execute DB --remote --config wrangler.d1.jsonc --env staging --file d1/data/staging-import.sql
